title: Proposed Planning API v2
description: v2 redesign: scene-in / routine-out, with refusal as a first-class return shape. Replaces v1's imperative step-emitting surface (movePose/gripClose/…). The wire format (five step types) is unchanged; v2 changes what the caller writes, not what the simulator executes.

scene.description: Full scene as defined by the simulator's scene schema.

context.description: Optional caller hints. A v2 impl may ignore any of these.

family.description: Carried over from v1's family concept. v2 allows the caller to label the scene shape, but v2 does not dispatch on it internally.

budgetMs.description: Soft wall-clock hint. v2 must still return within the budget, refusing early rather than running over.

planOutput.description: Either a routine (with steps) or a structured refusal. Exactly one shape.

steps.description: Wire steps in the existing five-type vocabulary. Unchanged from v1.

refusal.description: The key v2 addition. v1 leaked infeasibility through late ik_no_converge / collision_* violations at replay. v2 detects infeasibility in plan() and returns a structured refusal instead of emitting an unsafe routine.

steps.description: Must be empty on refusal. No partial routine is emitted — the caller sees either a safe routine or a refusal, never a best-effort violation.

scope.description: What the refusal applies to. A scene-scoped refusal means the whole scene is rejected; part/bin scope narrows the cause.

plan.description: plan(input) → output. Replaces v1's Routine builder + manual pose/grip sequencing.
